t2.title: Advertisements be banned during children's television programmes
t2.prompt: You are participating in an online discussion forum. The topic is: "Should advertisements be banned during children's television programmes?" Write your response, giving reasons and examples. Write 180–200 words.
t2.sample:
Advertisements during children's television programmes have long been controversial. I strongly believe they should be banned for several important reasons.

Firstly, young children cannot distinguish between entertainment and advertising. They are easily influenced by colorful, exciting commercials promoting unhealthy foods, sugary drinks, and expensive toys. This manipulation is ethically wrong and takes advantage of children's innocence.

Secondly, advertising contributes to childhood obesity and materialism. Fast food and confectionery advertisements encourage poor dietary choices, while toy commercials create pressure on parents to purchase products they cannot afford. Children who watch more advertisements develop stronger desires for material possessions.

Some argue that advertising funds children's programming and that banning it would reduce quality content. However, countries like Sweden have successfully banned advertising to children under 12 without negatively impacting children's television.

Alternatively, stricter regulations could limit advertising to educational products only, rather than complete bans.

In conclusion, protecting children from commercial exploitation should be prioritized over advertising revenue. Governments should implement bans or strict regulations on advertising during children's programmes to safeguard young viewers.
t2.sampleA1:
Hi,
I think ads are bad. Kids watch TV. Ads show toys. I want toys. My mom says no. Sad.
Bye
t2.sampleA2:
Hello,
I think ads on TV for kids are not good. Because kids see toys and they want them. And food too! The ads show sweets and chocolate. It is not healthy. My mom says no but I want it. It is difficult. Maybe no ads is better. But the TV shows are good too. So I don't know.
Thank you.
t2.sampleB1:
In my opinion, advertisements during children's TV shows should be limited. I think it's not fair to show kids lots of ads for toys and sweets because they don't always understand that the ads are trying to make them buy things. For example, my little brother always wants the toy he saw on TV, and he gets upset when my parents say no.
Also, many of the ads are for unhealthy food, like sugary cereals and fast food. This can encourage children to eat badly, which isn't good for their health. However, I understand that TV channels need money to make good shows, and advertising helps with that. Maybe there could be fewer ads, or only ads for healthy things.
So, I believe some changes are necessary to protect children.
t2.sampleB2: Hi everyone, This is a topic that's been on my mind for a while, so I'm curious to hear what you all think. Personally, I'm firmly in favour of banning ads during children's programmes. The main issue is that young kids simply can't tell the difference between a show and a commercial. They take everything at face value, which makes them easy targets for clever marketing. Most of these ads push sugary snacks and pricey toys, and that fuels both childhood obesity and endless pestering at the supermarket. I know some people will argue that adverts pay for the programmes we love, and to be fair, that's a valid point. But surely there are other ways to fund children's TV without cashing in on kids who don't know any better? At the end of the day, I think protecting children should come first. A total ban might be a stretch, but far stricter rules are long overdue. What's your take on this? Has anyone here seen how it works in countries that have already banned it? I'd love to hear your thoughts. Cheers, Sardor Usmonov
t2.uzSample:
Bolalarning teleko‘rsatuvlari vaqtida reklama berish uzoq vaqtdan beri bahsli masala bo‘lib kelgan. Men bir nechta muhim sabablarga ko‘ra, ularni taqiqlash kerak, deb qat’iy ishonaman.

Birinchidan, yosh bolalar ko‘ngilochar dasturlar va reklamani farqlay olmaydilar. Ular sog‘liq uchun zararli oziq-ovqatlar, shirin ichimliklar va qimmatbaho o‘yinchoqlarni targ‘ib qiluvchi rang-barang, hayajonli reklamalarning ta’siriga oson tushadilar. Bu manipulyatsiya axloqiy jihatdan noto‘g‘ri va bolalarning begunohligidan foydalanadi.

Ikkinchidan, reklama bolalar orasida semizlik va moddiylikning rivojlanishiga hissa qo‘shadi. Fast-fud va qandolat mahsulotlari reklamalari noto‘g‘ri ovqatlanish odatlarini rag‘batlantiradi, o‘yinchoq reklamalari esa ota-onalarga qurbi yetmaydigan mahsulotlarni sotib olish uchun bosim o‘tkazadi. Reklamalarni ko‘proq tomosha qiladigan bolalarda moddiy boyliklarga bo‘lgan xohish kuchayadi.

Ba’zilarning ta’kidlashicha, reklama bolalar ko‘rsatuvlarini moliyalashtiradi va uni taqiqlash sifatli kontentni kamaytiradi. Biroq, Shvetsiya kabi davlatlar bolalarga mo‘ljallangan teleko‘rsatuvlarga salbiy ta’sir ko‘rsatmagan holda, 12 yoshgacha bo‘lgan bolalarga reklamani muvaffaqiyatli taqiqlagan.

Yana bir yechim sifatida, to‘liq taqiq o‘rniga, qat’iyroq qoidalar reklamani faqat ta’lim mahsulotlari bilan cheklashi mumkin.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, bolalarni tijorat maqsadlarida ekspluatatsiya qilishdan himoya qilish reklama daromadidan ustun qo‘yilishi kerak. Hukumatlar yosh tomoshabinlarni himoya qilish uchun bolalar ko‘rsatuvlari vaqtida reklamaga taqiqlar yoki qat’iy qoidalar joriy etishi kerak.
t2.uzSampleA1:
Salom,
Menimcha reklamalar yomon. Bolalar televizor ko'rishadi. Reklamalarda o'yinchoqlar ko'rsatiladi. Men o'yinchoqlar xohlayman. Oyim yo'q deydi. Xafa bo'laman.
Xayr
t2.uzSampleA2:
Salom,
Menimcha, bolalar uchun televizorda reklama yaxshi emas. Chunki bolalar o'yinchoqlarni ko'rishadi va ularni xohlashadi. Va ovqat ham! Reklamalarda shirinliklar va shokolad ko'rsatiladi. Bu sog'lom emas. Onam yo'q deydi, lekin men xohlayman. Bu qiyin. Balki reklama bo'lmagani yaxshiroqdir. Lekin televizor ko'rsatuvlari ham yaxshi. Shuning uchun bilmayman.
Rahmat.
t2.uzSampleB1:
Mening fikrimcha, bolalar teleko‘rsatuvlari paytida reklamalar cheklanishi kerak. O‘ylaymanki, bolalarga o‘yinchoqlar va shirinliklar uchun ko‘plab reklamalarni ko‘rsatish adolatdan emas, chunki ular reklamalar ularni narsalarni sotib olishga undayotganini har doim ham tushunmaydilar. Misol uchun, ukam har doim televizorda ko‘rgan o‘yinchoqni xohlaydi va ota-onam yo‘q desa, xafa bo‘ladi.
Bundan tashqari, ko‘plab reklamalar sog‘lom bo‘lmagan ovqatlar, masalan, shakarli donlar va tez tayyorlanadigan ovqatlar uchun. Bu bolalarni yomon ovqatlanishga undashi mumkin, bu ularning sog‘lig‘i uchun yaxshi emas. Biroq, men telekanallarga yaxshi ko‘rsatuvlar yaratish uchun pul kerakligini va reklama bunga yordam berishini tushunaman. Balki reklamalar soni kamroq bo‘lishi mumkin, yoki faqat sog‘lom narsalar uchun reklamalar bo‘lishi mumkin.
Shunday qilib, men bolalarni himoya qilish uchun ba'zi o'zgarishlar zarur deb hisoblayman.
t2.uzSampleB2:
Bolalar teleko‘rsatuvlari davomida reklamaga oid bahslar murakkab masala, lekin men bunday reklamani butunlay taqiqlanmasa ham, qattiq cheklash kerak degan fikrga moyilman. Mening fikrim yosh bolalarning ishonarli marketing usullariga nisbatan zaifligidan kelib chiqadi.
Birinchidan, bolalar ko'pincha reklamalarda keltirilgan da'volarni tanqidiy baholash qobiliyatiga ega emaslar. Ular jozibali tasvirlar va esda qolarli shiorlar ta'siriga oson tushib, ularni eng yaxshi manfaatlariga mos kelmasligi mumkin bo'lgan mahsulotlarni, ayniqsa, zararli gazaklar va qimmatbaho o'yinchoqlarni xohlashga olib keladi. Bu ota-onalarga keraksiz bosim o'tkazadi va nosog'lom ovqatlanish odatlariga hissa qo'shishi mumkin.
Ikkinchidan, bolalarga qaratilgan reklamalarning haddan tashqari ko'pligi yoshlikdan iste'molchilik madaniyatini rivojlantirishi mumkin. Bolalar baxt va o'z qadr-qimmatini moddiy boyliklar bilan bog'lay boshlaydilar, bu esa rivojlantirish uchun zararli fikrlash tarzidir. Reklama daromadi, shubhasiz, bolalar dasturlarini ishlab chiqarishni qo'llab-quvvatlasa-da, yosh, ta'sirchan ongni ekspluatatsiya qilish bilan bog'liq axloqiy mulohazalar moliyaviy foydalardan ustun turadi. Reklama qilinadigan mahsulot turlari va qo'llaniladigan ishonchli usullarga e'tibor qaratgan holda, qat'iyroq qoidalar bolalarni reklamalarning potentsial zararli ta'siridan himoya qilish uchun zarurdir.

t11.title: informal letter · to friend
t11.prompt: Write a letter to your friend, who is worried about home security. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t11.sample: Hey! I heard about the break-ins in your neighborhood – that's really worrying. We recently installed a security system and it's made such a difference! We can check cameras from our phones and get instant alerts. You should definitely look into getting one too for peace of mind. Stay safe!
t11.sampleA1:
Hi Ozoda,
I have security system. I feel safe. You buy one? Bye!
t11.sampleA2:
Hi Ozoda,
I have a new security system at my house. I feel good and safe now. You are worried, but I think you should get a security system too. It is a good idea because it helps a lot. See you later!
t11.sampleB1:
Hi Ozoda,
I heard you're worried about security. I understand because there have been some problems recently. We got a security system installed, and honestly, it's made me feel much safer. I can check the cameras on my phone, which is really useful. In my opinion, you should consider getting one too. It might give you some peace of mind.
Best,
Rayhona Rahimova
t11.sampleB2: Hey Ozoda! I heard you've been worried sick about home security lately, and honestly, I don't blame you. We had a security system put in a couple of months ago and it's been a total game-changer — I sleep so much better now. You can check the cameras straight from your phone. Honestly, you should look into it. It's worth every penny! Take care, Bekzod Aliyev
t11.uzSample:
Salom!

Sening mahallangda o‘g‘irliklar bo‘lganini eshitdim – bu juda tashvishli. Biz yaqinda xavfsizlik tizimini o‘rnatdik va bu juda katta o‘zgarish qildi! Biz telefonlarimizdan kameralarni tekshira olamiz va tezkor ogohlantirishlar olamiz. Sen ham xotirjamlik uchun albatta shunday tizim o‘rnatishni ko‘rib chiqishing kerak.

O‘zingni ehtiyot qil!
t11.uzSampleA1:
Salom, Ozoda,
Menda xavfsizlik tizimi bor. Men o'zimni xavfsiz his qilyapman. Sen ham sotib olasanmi? Xayr!
t11.uzSampleA2:
Salom, Ozoda,
Mening uyimda yangi xavfsizlik tizimi bor. Men o'zimni yaxshi va xavfsiz his qilyapman. Siz xavotirdasiz, lekin menimcha siz ham xavfsizlik tizimini o'rnatishingiz kerak. Bu yaxshi fikr, chunki u juda yordam beradi. Ko'rishguncha!
t11.uzSampleB1:
Salom Ozoda,
Eshitishimcha, xavfsizlik haqida xavotirdasiz. Men sizni tushunaman, chunki yaqinda muammolar bo'lgan. Biz xavfsizlik tizimini o'rnatdik va rostini aytsam, bu meni ancha xavfsiz his qildirdi. Men telefonimda kameralarni tekshira olaman, bu juda foydali. Mening fikrimcha, siz ham shuni o'rnatishni o'ylab ko'rishingiz kerak. Bu sizga xotirjamlik berishi mumkin.
Eng yaxshi tilaklar bilan,
Rayhona Rahimova
t11.uzSampleB2:
Salom Ozoda,
Sizning hududingizdagi so'nggi xavfsizlik muammolari haqida eshitib juda xafa bo'ldim. Sizning xavotirda ekanligingizni to'liq tushunaman. Biz bir necha hafta oldin uy xavfsizlik tizimini o'rnatdik va u bizning tashvishlarimizni kamaytirishda juda samarali bo'ldi. Mulkni ilova orqali masofadan turib kuzatish imkoniyati ayniqsa ishonchlidir. Men chin dildan shunga o'xshash tizimga sarmoya kiritish sizga, ayniqsa vaziyatni hisobga olgan holda, sezilarli darajada xotirjamlik beradi deb o'ylayman. Sizga mavjud bo'lgan variantlarni o'rganishga arziydi.
Eng yaxshi tilaklar bilan,
Rayhona Rahimova

t12.title: formal letter · to recipient
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the security company. Write about your feelings and what you think they should do.
t12.sample: Dear SafeHome Customer Support, Thank you for your email asking about my experience with your home security system. I am very satisfied with the protection your system provides. The installation team were professional and explained all features clearly. The mobile app is intuitive, allowing me to monitor cameras and receive instant alerts wherever I am. I particularly appreciate the motion-sensor lights. However, I have encountered some minor issues. Occasionally, the app takes time to load camera feeds, which could be frustrating during an emergency. I would suggest improving server response times. Additionally, I would appreciate having more customizable alert settings to reduce false alarms from pets moving around the house. Overall, your system has given my family peace of mind, and I would recommend SafeHome to neighbors. Yours sincerely, Rayhona Rahimova
t12.sampleA1:
Hi SafeHome!

I like the security. It is good. The app is okay. Thank you. Bye.
t12.sampleA2:
Dear SafeHome,

Thank you for the security system. I like it, and I feel safe now. The app is easy to use, and the cameras are good. But sometimes the app is slow. I want more cameras for the garden because the garden is dark. Thank you very much.

Bye,

Rayhona Rahimova
t12.sampleB1:
Dear SafeHome Customer Support,

Thank you for your email. I wanted to tell you about the security system I got from you. I think it's pretty good. The installation was fine, and the man was nice. The app is easy to use, and I like that I can see the cameras on my phone.

However, I have a few problems. Sometimes the app doesn't work very well, and it's slow. Also, I think it would be good if you had a louder alarm. Maybe you could add that in the future?

Overall, I'm happy with the system. Thanks!

Sincerely,
Rayhona Rahimova
t12.sampleB2: Dear SafeHome Customer Support, Thank you for getting in touch to ask how I'm finding my new home security system. On the whole, I'm delighted with it. The installation went smoothly, and your engineer took the time to walk me through every feature. The mobile app is straightforward to use, and being able to check the cameras remotely gives me real peace of mind. That said, there are a couple of things you might look at. The motion sensors are a little oversensitive, so my cat keeps setting off false alarms. It would also be handy to have more control over which alerts I receive. All in all, though, I'm very happy with the service and wouldn't hesitate to recommend you to my neighbours. Yours sincerely, Dilnoza Karimova
t12.uzSample:
Hurmatli SafeHome mijozlarni qo'llab-quvvatlash xizmati,

Sizning uy xavfsizlik tizimingiz bilan bog'liq tajribam haqida so'raganingiz uchun rahmat.

Sizning tizimingiz ta'minlayotgan himoyadan juda mamnunman. O'rnatish guruhi professional edi va barcha funksiyalarni aniq tushuntirdi. Mobil ilova intuitiv bo'lib, menga kameralarni kuzatish va qayerda bo'lishimdan qat'i nazar, tezkor ogohlantirishlar olish imkonini beradi. Men, ayniqsa, harakat sensori chiroqlarini qadrlayman.

Biroq, men ba'zi kichik muammolarga duch keldim. Ba'zida, ilova kamera tasvirlarini yuklash uchun vaqt talab qiladi, bu favqulodda vaziyatda asabiylashishi mumkin. Men serverning javob berish vaqtini yaxshilashni taklif qilaman.

Bundan tashqari, uy hayvonlarining uy atrofida harakatlanishidan kelib chiqadigan soxta signalizatsiyalarni kamaytirish uchun ko'proq sozlanishi mumkin bo'lgan ogohlantirish sozlamalariga ega bo'lishni xohlardim.

Umuman olganda, sizning tizimingiz oilamga xotirjamlik berdi va men SafeHome'ni qo'shnilarimga tavsiya qilaman.

Hurmat bilan,
Rayhona Rahimova

Biroq, menimcha, yaxshilanishi mumkin bo'lgan bir nechta sohalar mavjud. Birinchidan, harakat datchiklarining sezgirligi juda yuqori ko'rinadi, natijada kichik hayvonlar tomonidan tez-tez soxta signallar beriladi. Ilova ichidagi sezgirlik sozlamalarini sozlash unchalik intuitiv emas. Ikkinchidan, men bildirishnoma sozlamalarini yanada batafsil nazorat qilishni xohlardim, bu esa menga ayrim ogohlantirishlarni boshqalardan ustun qo'yish imkonini beradi.

Ushbu kichik kamchiliklarga qaramay, men SafeHome xavfsizlik tizimidan mamnunman va uni boshqalarga tavsiya qilishni o'ylab ko'raman.

Rayhona Rahimova
